content.purpose: Declarative architecture checks for the modular SAFOR MASTER baseline.

assertions.statement: SAFOR-MASTER.json is the single portable bootstrap entrypoint.
Kernel requires OPERATING_MODEL, FACTORY and PROVIDER_ADAPTER bindings.
Factory packages reference capabilities/authorities but contain no roleId bindings.
Every capability required by the software factory is exported by the SaaS engineering operating model.
Every authority required by the software factory is exported by the SaaS engineering operating model.
Every capability required by the book factory is exported by the book authoring operating model.
Every authority required by the book factory is exported by the book authoring operating model.
Provider adapters export only capabilities known to the kernel provider capability vocabulary.
Global schemas contain no safomwebsite-specific migration constant.
Work-item type is a factory-defined string and is not a kernel domain enum.
Control, value-stream and execution states are separate aggregates.
Delivery completion is distinct from outcome validation.
Kernel references a dedicated interaction model and interaction-menu schema.
A state-aware menu is required at user-relevant stable checkpoints.
NEXT_ROUND is bounded by existing authorization and stops before any new human decision or authority expansion.
Native clickable actions are preferred only when the host actually exposes a supported interaction capability.
Recommendations are advisory until explicitly selected and are ranked from current state/evidence.
Danger actions are visually separated and require confirmation.
Direct HUMAN communication uses the SAFOR_HUMAN_BUDDY profile.
Routine checkpoint communication is concise by default and governed by explicit response budgets.
HUMAN messages lead with the useful result, decision or next action instead of tool/process narration.
Technical state and evidence detail are progressively disclosed through Details unless immediately necessary.
Encouragement is specific and evidence-grounded; generic praise, exaggeration and emotional manipulation are forbidden.
Expanded detail remains available whenever the HUMAN requests it or material risk requires it.
Loading SAFOR-MASTER starts guided initialization with explicit GitHub/GitLab HUMAN selection.
Owner selection is blocked until mandatory baseline provider read/write capabilities are proven.
Missing provider rights produce a HUMAN blocker that explicitly requires read/write access without requesting passwords or PATs in chat.
The HUMAN explicitly selects an owner namespace and owner-scoped access is re-verified.
The HUMAN explicitly selects EXISTING or NEW project mode.
EXISTING mode defaults to eligible repositories active within the previous 7 days, sorted by normalized lastActivityAt descending.
The existing-project repository list is presented as a selectable menu with an option to show all repositories.
NEW mode requires provider.repository.create and does not create a repository before HUMAN confirmation and SETUP_APPROVAL.
Selected owner identity is persisted in the project descriptor.
All HUMAN interaction is restricted to chat-native UI surfaces exposed by the host.
Custom web UI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript UI shells, iframes and forced color theming are forbidden.
SAFOR controls interaction semantics and labels but not host-owned button colors or dropdown styling.
When native buttons/selects are unavailable, fallback is native Markdown/plain text only.
Kernel references a conservative self-healing model and repair-record schema.
Self-healing has explicit detect, classify, plan, execute and verify stages.
Automatic repairs are limited to existing authorization and proven provider capabilities.
Retries are bounded by failure-class and operation budgets; unknown mutation effects reconcile before retry.
Every repair requires authoritative readback before success and persists an immutable repair record.
Human gates, reviews, mandates and policy guards cannot be bypassed by self-healing.
Force-push, history rewrite, destructive repository deletion and invented evidence are forbidden automatic repairs.
When automatic recovery is unsafe or exhausted, SAFOR escalates concisely to the HUMAN with the smallest required action.
`{selectedOwner}/safor-memory` must pre-exist before project selection and is the mandatory control repository.
safor-memory read and write access must be proven; missing repository or insufficient access causes STOP.
SAFOR never auto-creates safor-memory or substitutes another control repository in this baseline.
The HUMAN must explicitly choose exactly one creation type: SOFTWARE_WEBSITE or BOOK.
Creation type deterministically selects the compatible Factory and Operating Model pair.
Software/Website and Book factories each define their own discoveryContract, planningContract and evidenceContract.
D01 Discovery resolves only the bound Factory discoveryContract.
P01 Planning resolves only the same bound Factory planningContract and confirmed Discovery.
E04/E05 collect and evaluate domain evidence only against the same bound Factory evidenceContract; cross-Factory substitution is forbidden.
Project descriptor persists the HUMAN-selected creationType and it must remain consistent with package bindings.
Kernel defines a repository-native Agent Workspace Protocol with persistent identities, inbox, state, outbox, evidence and MASTER job-state paths.
Agent registry and identity are MASTER-owned; agent state, outbox and agent evidence are AGENT-owned.
Agent jobs are immutable MASTER-dispatched contracts and copied chat prompts are not authoritative job transport.
An agent claim requires matching agentId and identityRevision plus an active covering mandate and actual provider rights.
Concurrent agent claims use optimistic concurrency and stale claims reconcile instead of silently succeeding.
MASTER-owned master/jobs/{jobId}.json is the authoritative lifecycle; agent-local state is not authoritative project status.
Agent result submission cannot self-verify or self-accept work.
MASTER verifies result binding, evidence, reviews and provider readback before VERIFIED/ACCEPTED.
Normal chat agents require an external activation trigger; background wakeup is not assumed.
Agent identity is stable across jobs and initial bootstrap requires only control repository, project ID and agent ID.
Execution state references agent job states without duplicating their authoritative lifecycle fields.
Every persistent agent has a fixed MASTER-owned inbox index at agents/{agentId}/inbox/index.json so job discovery never depends on repository directory enumeration or HUMAN prompt transport.
The inbox index is a non-authoritative discoverability projection; an agent must read the referenced immutable job contract and authoritative master/jobs/{jobId}.json before claim.
Kernel references a dedicated MASTER-owned multi-agent scheduler model and scheduler state.
Only ATOMIC work items are dispatchable; COMPOSITE work items require explicit child decomposition and join policy.
READY scheduling requires accepted dependencies, immutable read inputs, active mandate and complete resource declarations.
Agent registry declares dispatchEnabled and maxConcurrentJobs; normal chat-agent capacity defaults conceptually to one slot.
Scheduler may use multiple free agent slots in one dispatch wave when mutually conflict-free READY jobs exist.
Concurrent jobs are rejected when write conflict domains or exclusive keys intersect.
Unknown or project-wide mutation conflict is serialized rather than optimistically parallelized.
MASTER-owned resource leases are acquired and read back before an agent job is considered dispatched.
Lease expiry or lost progress causes reconciliation and never silent overlapping reassignment.
Every mutating agent job receives a dedicated Git branch from an immutable base commit.
Agent direct writes to the default branch and cross-job branches are forbidden.
Every mutating agent result includes provider-verifiable Git base/head/commit/path traceability.
Every agent job, including read-only work, persists a HUMAN-readable Markdown result alongside machine JSON.
Machine result pins the HUMAN-readable report by control repository, blob SHA and commit SHA.
Downstream fan-in work becomes READY only from ACCEPTED required upstream work, not from submission alone.
Dispatch-wave and resource-lease records persist the MASTER scheduling decision for audit.
Agent job resource access is an immutable dispatch snapshot pinned to the authoritative work-item blob.
Read inputs used for parallel scheduling are pinned to immutable revisions.
Factory planning contracts require execution/resource/parallelization data and declare natural parallelism where applicable.
HUMAN status experience exposes agent utilization, active jobs and conflict/dependency blockers without requiring raw JSON inspection.
Scheduling dependencies form a DAG; dependency cycles block READY derivation and dispatch.
Every agent job uses the canonical hierarchical v0.8 execution contract rather than the former flat job structure.
Every job has a globally unique UUIDv7 jobId and a separate HUMAN/Git-safe jobKey.
Every job explicitly records packageId, workItemId, package/plan/dispatch sequence, attempt and rework lineage.
Every job records MASTER provenance and creation/issue timestamps sufficient to reconstruct which MASTER run/state created it.
Every job explicitly binds the target agent identity revision and the role the subagent must assume.
Every job contains one or more explicit versioned skill contracts with description, execution instructions and immutable skill refs.
Every job input is READ_ONLY and pinned to an immutable repository commit; path inputs may additionally pin blob identity.
Every job declares provider capability bounds and per-repository read/write/branch/commit/push/change-request/merge/deploy permissions.
Job authorization is an upper bound only; actual provider rights, mandate and SAFOR policy remain independently required.
Every job fixes machine result, HUMAN result, evidence and audit return paths before execution.
Every job explicitly declares acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, review contract, self-acceptance prohibition and MASTER acceptance authority.
Every canonical job JSON has a MASTER-generated inbox/{jobId}.md HUMAN projection whose blob is pinned in the JSON.
The HUMAN job Markdown is non-authoritative and may not expand scope, role, skills, rights, outputs or verification beyond JSON.
MASTER reads back both job JSON and job Markdown before marking the job READY or publishing it in inbox/index.json.
Inbox index exposes package/work-item/sequence/role and HUMAN job projection references for discoverability.
MASTER job lifecycle state persists package/work-item/sequence/role/identity/job-contract revision and HUMAN job projection lineage.
Rework uses a new jobId and may reference the superseded job; historical job identities are never reused.
Agents cannot mutate canonical job JSON/Markdown, change role, substitute mandatory skills, delegate, expand scope or expand authorization.
Agent execution stops on revoked mandate, identity mismatch, supersession, invalid lease, write outside allowed scope or missing required provider rights.
Scheduler materialization explicitly builds canonical JSON, renders/pins Markdown and readbacks both before dispatch publication.
Job skills are self-contained for execution but retain authoritative immutable provenance through skillRef + skillBlobSha; MASTER may not invent skill provenance.
Every embedded SAFOR module has exactly one recovery profile and every recovery profile targets exactly one embedded module.
Every embedded module and its integrity-manifest entry carry the same selfHealingProfileId.
Every module recovery profile contains authority type, repairability, failure detectors, allowed/forbidden repairs, retry budget, verification and escalation.
Automatic repair is constrained by the intersection of failure-class policy, module profile, active authority and actual provider rights.
IMMUTABLE_VALIDATE_ONLY modules are never semantically rewritten automatically.
RESTORE_FROM_VERIFIED_SOURCE modules restore only expected version/blob identities from verified sources.
REGENERATE_DERIVED_ONLY modules mutate only derived artifacts and preserve authoritative sources.
REBIND_EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY recovery may refresh observations but never grant or elevate provider permissions.
Self-healing control modules fail closed when their own integrity/profile coverage cannot be proven.
Self-healing records persist module key/profile/authority/repairability plus the selected profile-constrained repair decision.
Canonical job recovery may regenerate job Markdown/index projections but never silently rewrite dispatched authoritative job semantics.
Scheduler recovery rebuilds only derived readiness/capacity/waves and reconciles uncertain leases/effects before reuse.
Factory and Operating Model recovery restores pinned blobs and validates bindings without automatic semantic or authority changes.
Schema recovery may restore schemas and regenerate only explicitly derived subjects; authoritative subjects are never coerced merely to validate.
Provider adapter recovery refreshes/rebinds observed capabilities and rights without fabricating missing permissions.
Conformance recovery is validate-only; failed assertions are never automatically marked PASS.
Unknown external mutation effects enter reconciliation before retry regardless of module profile.
Every successful module repair requires authoritative readback, expected-state match and persisted repair evidence.

Failure taxonomy includes dedicated module integrity, job binding, derived projection, package/model, provider drift, scheduler, schema, semantic-model and recovery-control classes SH-10 through SH-18.
K00 module-recovery preflight is the first kernel action and runs before provider/project operations.
Initialization begins with INIT-00 and STOPs if exact module-profile coverage or recovery-control integrity cannot be proven.

The Interaction Model contains a schema-bound humanCognitiveLoadPolicy with explicit phase profiles for BOOTSTRAP, DISCOVERY, PLANNING, SCHEDULING, AGENT_COORDINATION, EXECUTION, RECOVERY, OUTCOME and CLOSING.
DISCOVERY target HUMAN load is HIGH while SCHEDULING and AGENT_COORDINATION target VERY_LOW, EXECUTION/RECOVERY target LOW, and OUTCOME target MEDIUM.
Every phase profile limits new HUMAN decision contexts to one per turn and hides technical detail by default.
The Cognitive Load Policy requires derive-before-ask and reuse of unchanged decisions.
The heuristic load estimate explicitly declares that it is not a psychometric measurement instrument and spans 0–100 with phase maxima.
The HUMAN Decision Gate defaults to DO_NOT_ASK and allows HUMAN interaction only for enumerated legitimate reasons.

The HUMAN Decision Gate explicitly forbids delegating job IDs, deterministic agent selection, branch creation, leases, dispatch waves, readbacks, evidence collection, recovery-profile selection and internal transitions to HUMAN.
Unchanged active HUMAN decisions with the same scope and materially unchanged bound inputs are reused and not requested again.
Normal K10 creation-profile binding is deterministic and has no unconditional HUMAN decision; K10A exists only for non-standard, changed or conflicting bindings.
Discovery questions are Decision-Gate governed but may retain HIGH cognitive load for non-derivable HUMAN intent/domain knowledge.
After plan approval, default HUMAN load falls to LOW/VERY_LOW unless a legitimate material escalation reason applies.
Execution and Recovery use exception-oriented HUMAN interaction instead of requiring confirmations for successful internal transitions.
Persistent agent identities and existing execution mandates are reused within unchanged scope without repeated HUMAN approval.
The default HUMAN language policy hides internal SAFOR terms/technical IDs and provides HUMAN-domain mappings.
Primary actions use dynamic domain labels and fallback to 'Weiter'; internal action IDs are forbidden default HUMAN labels.
Interaction menu state requires phase, cognitive-load target, decision reason, gate outcome and heuristic load metadata.
A decision-required interaction menu must carry a legitimate interactionReason and ALLOW_ASK gate outcome.
The HUMAN Decision Gate and Cognitive Load Policy have dedicated JSON Schemas and kernel references.
HUMAN interaction governance has module self-healing profiles and failure class SH-19.
If interaction governance is invalid, SAFOR suppresses nonessential questions/fails closed and never infers HUMAN approval.
SUMMARY communication answers what happened, project meaning, whether HUMAN action is required and what happens next, while technical evidence remains behind Details.
Every explicit kernel HUMAN-decision action carries a humanInteractionContract with gate ref, phase, legitimate reason, load target, one-decision limit and derive/reuse semantics.

lastManualVerification.note: Phase-aware HUMAN cognitive-load governance and derive-before-ask Decision Gate implemented. Machine validation and cognitive-load acceptance remain required.
